correctness.rationale: Each closed neighborhood is constructed exactly from the 24-vertex cyclic-edge definition. A monitoring set separates u and v iff it hits N[u] symmetric-difference N[v], yielding exactly 24 domination and 276 pairwise separation constraints. Two independently coded complete enumerations check all 735471 size-eight and 1307504 size-nine subsets: none at eight, 48 at nine. The identifying property is monotone, excluding smaller sizes. The 48 natural graph automorphisms are checked on all edges and map one explicit optimum to precisely all 48 enumerated optima, with stage-count profile (2,3,4) in six orders of eight. The full independently stored optimizer list matches both verifiers; no infinite claim is made.

broader_coverage.reasoning: A general lower bound eight does not imply the strictly larger minimum nine; an upper-bound construction whose domain starts at dimension four does not apply to dimension three. Zero forcing is a different predicate from identifying codes, and its butterfly graph has a different edge/stage model. No dominating theorem or equality-case census located implies the result.

value.rationale: The cyclic binary butterfly is a natural parallel-computing interconnection network. Dimension three is the smallest nondegenerate four-regular instance and is outside the 2009 m>=4 constructive theorem. Determining the exact extra sensor beyond the generic eight bound, enumerating every 9-sensor design, and proving all 48 layouts form one free transitive natural symmetry orbit supplies a complete useful finite design classification and a canonical optimal solution. It is not a renamed bound, and no unproved dimensional extrapolation is made.
